fins.name: Anal_mesh

crop_registration.scope: Actual atlas alpha near full independently traced basal line versus retained source matte rule; tests crop registration without body distance.

fins.selection_basis: Retained independently traced native root polyline; complete 17 native-pixel band from prepare_native_fin_review.py. Earlier profile baseline is not used as root ownership.

fins.current_source_parameter_storage: retained domain values and tail ancestry; no anatomical u/v/t point attributes in this packed source

limitations: The old source-domain crop files were retired. Crop origins reconstructed as max(0,floor(original profile polygon bbox)-24), independently checked against actual clipped basal alpha and historical complete-bank cardinality.
Current source UV used only for genuine cap coordinates. Carp wall color UV is excluded; exact colocated source cap ownership is propagated to every packed duplicate.
No 490/static root signed distance, membrane clearance, or visual acceptance run here.
Historical model/source paths and retired authoring intermediates are provenance only. Current anatomical values and identity tables are retained here; color UV must not redefine the anatomical band.
This maintenance data is not a new physical or visual acceptance report.
